name: Police- Community Relations Awards 2016
description:
This dataset lists the four organizations that received New York City Police-Community Relations Awards in fiscal year 2016, each awarded $12,000. For every recipient it records the organization name, project title, and project street address, along with geographic identifiers including postcode, borough, latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot number (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). Three of the projects are in Manhattan and one is in Brooklyn, spanning neighborhoods such as Washington Heights South, Central Harlem South, the Lower East Side, and DUMBO-Downtown Brooklyn.

Because the file is so small, it works best as a reference list or as a supplement to larger datasets rather than for statistical analysis on its own. It can be used to map where award-funded community policing projects were located, to report transparently on how awards were distributed across boroughs, districts, and neighborhoods, or to join
